scope: Bounded review and fix verification of persistence and engine changes authored by another agent; no production edits made by reviewer.
sourceIdentityNote: Reviewed uncommitted working-tree files are identified by SHA-256 below. Original pre-fix hashes were not recorded; no retrospective hash claim is made.

originalReview.result: Five original diagnostic cases passed by reproducing four findings (serialization finding included a separate accessor case).

additionalReviewRound.result: Six diagnostics passed: five desired assertions verified initial fixes; one positive reproduction confirmed the duty restart deadline coherence gap.

intermediateRerun.explanation: Lead fixed the additional deadline issue before its positive reproduction assertion was converted. The old reproduction then failed with STATE_DUTY_DEADLINE, confirming rejection. The final desired-behavior run below supersedes it.

findings.title: Fault set and equipment state disagree
findings.reproduction: Create a duty-pump trip at t=0, change only its equipment state from failed to running, then validate/export/import/restore/advance one second. Original code admitted the checkpoint and changed coolant and energy.

findings.title: Standalone state is not bound to complete design
findings.reproduction: Change config.idleFraction while keeping design.revision. Original validateState and advance accepted the prior checkpoint under the new design.

findings.title: Array serialization hooks/accessors bypass structural validation
findings.reproduction: An own assets.toJSON returning [] passes validation and emits an unreadable export; array numeric getters execute instead of rejection.

findings.title: Legacy mixed sequences are admitted but cannot recalculate
findings.reproduction: Admit two same-time legacy events with explicit sequence 1 and omitted sequence; old recalculation assigns duplicate sequence 1.

findings.title: Duty startup deadline contradicts recorded restore
findings.reproduction: Restore duty at t=0; alter its future deadline from 3 to 8. Original post-first-fix validation admitted this and retained starting state at t=4.

assertions.name: rejects fault/equipment incoherence before restore and retains valid continuation
rejects array serialization hooks without executing them
rejects array accessors without reading them
recalculates admitted legacy mixed sequences in stable file order and retains parent provenance
rejects config and connection changes despite an unchanged revision string
rejects a duty startup deadline inconsistent with its latest restore while preserving valid startup

verification.interpretation: All six final cases use desired behavior assertions: rejection of each malformed checkpoint or unsafe serialization object, successful legacy recalculation, and exact valid restored continuation. They verify five reproduced findings; array hooks and accessors have separate cases.

reviewStatus: All reproduced review findings verified fixed
limitations: Bounded adversarial review, not exhaustive proof of all state invariants.
No browser, remote, CI or deployment operations were part of this review.
Durable production regression tests are owned by the lead; temporary diagnostic sources remain in artifacts.
